Invalid rules or parsed values may select in Rust, diverge from Python rule_matches, and fail or truncate later during residue encoding.","acceptance_criteria":"Add one centralized validation path used before every MO/CDA match. Reject descriptor widths outside 1..=128 and reject present field values, target values when applicable, and every mapping value that is not representable in length_bits. Apply this consistently to Equal, MSB including MSB(0), MatchMapping, and Ignore with all CDAs. Define handling for malformed static/custom rules without panics. Add boundary tests for widths 0, 1, 128, and 129; values and TVs at max, max+1; invalid mapping members; all MO/CDA combinations; and Rust/Python parity.
